# Canvas Escape

- **Genre:** Top‑down maze explorer
- **Controls:** Arrow keys move a small circle
- **Objective:** Navigate a randomly generated labyrinth drawn on an HTML canvas to reach the exit portal.
- **Lose condition:** The player loses if the circle touches a wall or if a 30‑second timer runs out.

This concept fits within a single HTML canvas and includes a clear fail state.

1: // Canvas Escape game implementation
2: // Target canvas element with id="game"
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return;
6:   // Audio setup
7:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
8:   function playTone(freq, dur) {
9:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
10:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
11:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
12:     osc.type = 'sine';
13:     osc.connect(gain);
14:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
15:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
16:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
17:     osc.start();
18:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + dur / 1000);
19:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + dur / 1000);
20:   }
21:   // background hum (low frequency)
22:   const humOsc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
23:   const humGain = audioCtx.createGain();
24:   humOsc.frequency.value = 40;
25:   humOsc.type = 'sine';
26:   humOsc.connect(humGain);
27:   humGain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
28:   humGain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.02, audioCtx.currentTime);
29:   humOsc.start();
30:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
31:   const WIDTH = canvas.width = 400;
32:   const HEIGHT = canvas.height = 400;
33:   const COLS = 20;
34:   const ROWS = 20;
35:   const CELL = WIDTH / COLS;
36:   const PLAYER_R = 5;
37:   const SPEED = 2;
38:   // starfield settings
39:   const STAR_COUNT = 100;
40:   const stars = [];
41:   // initialize starfield
42:   for (let i = 0; i < STAR_COUNT; i++) {
43:     stars.push({
44:       x: Math.random() * WIDTH,
45:       y: Math.random() * HEIGHT,
46:       r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
47:     });
48:   }
49: 
50:   // Maze generation (recursive backtracker)
51:   const cells = [];
52:   for (let y = 0; y < ROWS; y++) {
53:     cells[y] = [];
54:     for (let x = 0; x < COLS; x++) {
55:       cells[y][x] = { visited: false, walls: [true, true, true, true] }; // top,right,bottom,left
56:     }
57:   }
58:   function shuffle(a) { for (let i = a.length - 1; i > 0; i--) { const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1)); [a[i], a[j]] = [a[j], a[i]]; } return a; }
59:   function carve(x, y) {
60:     cells[y][x].visited = true;
61:     const dirs = shuffle([0, 1, 2, 3]); // 0:top 1:right 2:bottom 3:left
62:     for (const d of dirs) {
63:       const nx = x + (d === 1 ? 1 : d === 3 ? -1 : 0);
64:       const ny = y + (d === 2 ? 1 : d === 0 ? -1 : 0);
65:       if (nx < 0 || nx >= COLS || ny < 0 || ny >= ROWS) continue;
66:       if (cells[ny][nx].visited) continue;
67:       // remove walls between (x,y) and (nx,ny)
68:       cells[y][x].walls[d] = false;
69:       cells[ny][nx].walls[(d + 2) % 4] = false;
70:       carve(nx, ny);
71:     }
72:   }
73:   carve(0, 0);
74: 
75:   // Player & exit
76:   const player = { x: CELL / 2, y: CELL / 2 };
77:   const exit = { x: (COLS - 0.5) * CELL, y: (ROWS - 0.5) * CELL };
78:   const keys = { ArrowUp: false, ArrowDown: false, ArrowLeft: false, ArrowRight: false };
79:   let audioStarted = false;
80: window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
81:   if (!audioStarted) { audioCtx.resume(); audioStarted = true; }
82:   if (keys.hasOwnProperty(e.key)) keys[e.key] = true;
83: });
84:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { if (keys.hasOwnProperty(e.key)) keys[e.key] = false; });
85: 
86:   let timeLeft = 30; // seconds
87:   const timerId = setInterval(() => { timeLeft--; if (timeLeft <= 0) endGame(false); }, 1000);
88: 
89:   function endGame(win) {
90:     clearInterval(timerId);
91:     // stop background hum
92:     humOsc.stop();
93:     // play result tone
94:     playTone(win ? 440 : 150, 400);
95:     alert(win ? 'You win!' : 'Game over');
96:     // stop animation loop
97:     cancelAnimationFrame(animId);
98:   }
99: 
100:   function movePlayer() {
101:     let dx = 0, dy = 0;
102:     if (keys.ArrowUp) dy -= SPEED;
103:     if (keys.ArrowDown) dy += SPEED;
104:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) dx -= SPEED;
105:     if (keys.ArrowRight) dx += SPEED;
106:     if (dx === 0 && dy === 0) return;
107:     const newX = player.x + dx;
108:     const newY = player.y + dy;
109:     // Determine current cell
110:     const cellX = Math.floor(player.x / CELL);
111:     const cellY = Math.floor(player.y / CELL);
112:     // Check wall collisions per direction
113:     if (dx < 0 && cells[cellY][cellX].walls[3]) { // left wall
114:       if (newX - PLAYER_R < cellX * CELL) { playTone(200,150); return; }
115:     }
116:     if (dx > 0 && cells[cellY][cellX].walls[1]) { // right wall
117:       if (newX + PLAYER_R > (cellX + 1) * CELL) return;
118:     }
119:     if (dy < 0 && cells[cellY][cellX].walls[0]) { // top wall
120:       if (newY - PLAYER_R < cellY * CELL) return;
121:     }
122:     if (dy > 0 && cells[cellY][cellX].walls[2]) { // bottom wall
123:       if (newY + PLAYER_R > (cellY + 1) * CELL) return;
124:     }
125:     player.x = newX;
126:     player.y = newY;
127:   }
128: 
129:   let frameCount = 0;
130:   function draw() {
131:     // starfield
132:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
133:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT);
134:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
135:     for (const s of stars) {
136:       ctx.beginPath();
137:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
138:       ctx.fill();
139:       // slight twinkle
140:       s.r += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.05;
141:       if (s.r < 0.5) s.r = 0.5;
142:       if (s.r > 2) s.r = 2;
143:     }
144:     // background gradient overlay for depth
145:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT);
146:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#111');
147:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#222');
148:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
149:     ctx.globalAlpha = 0.3;
150:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT);
151:     ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
152:     // draw maze walls with crisp color
153:     ctx.strokeStyle = '#888';
154:     ctx.lineWidth = 2;
155:     for (let y = 0; y < ROWS; y++) {
156:       for (let x = 0; x < COLS; x++) {
157:         const c = cells[y][x];
158:         const px = x * CELL;
159:         const py = y * CELL;
160:         ctx.beginPath();
161:         if (c.walls[0]) ctx.moveTo(px, py), ctx.lineTo(px + CELL, py);
162:         if (c.walls[1]) ctx.moveTo(px + CELL, py), ctx.lineTo(px + CELL, py + CELL);
163:         if (c.walls[2]) ctx.moveTo(px + CELL, py + CELL), ctx.lineTo(px, py + CELL);
164:         if (c.walls[3]) ctx.moveTo(px, py + CELL), ctx.lineTo(px, py);
165:         ctx.stroke();
166:       }
167:     }
168:     // draw exit portal with pulsing glow
169:     const pulse = (Math.sin(frameCount * 0.1) + 1) / 2; // 0..1
170:     const exitGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(exit.x, exit.y, CELL / 4, exit.x, exit.y, CELL / 2);
171:     exitGrad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(0,255,0,${0.6 + 0.4 * pulse})`);
172:     exitGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
173:     ctx.fillStyle = exitGrad;
174:     ctx.beginPath();
175:     ctx.arc(exit.x, exit.y, CELL / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
176:     ctx.fill();
177:     // draw player with glow
178:     const pGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(player.x, player.y, PLAYER_R, player.x, player.y, PLAYER_R * 4);
179:     pGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,0,0,0.8)');
180:     pGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,0,0,0)');
181:     ctx.fillStyle = pGrad;
182:     ctx.beginPath();
183:     ctx.arc(player.x, player.y, PLAYER_R, 0, Math.PI * 2);
184:     ctx.fill();
185:     // timer text
186:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
187:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
188:     ctx.fillText(`Time: ${timeLeft}s`, 10, HEIGHT - 10);
189:     frameCount++;
190:   }
191:     // background gradient
192:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT);
193:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#111');
194:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#222');
195:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
196:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT);
197: 
198:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT);
199:     // draw maze walls
200:     ctx.strokeStyle = '#000';
201:     ctx.lineWidth = 2;
202:     for (let y = 0; y < ROWS; y++) {
203:       for (let x = 0; x < COLS; x++) {
204:         const c = cells[y][x];
205:         const px = x * CELL;
206:         const py = y * CELL;
207:         ctx.beginPath();
208:         if (c.walls[0]) ctx.moveTo(px, py), ctx.lineTo(px + CELL, py); // top
209:         if (c.walls[1]) ctx.moveTo(px + CELL, py), ctx.lineTo(px + CELL, py + CELL); // right
210:         if (c.walls[2]) ctx.moveTo(px + CELL, py + CELL), ctx.lineTo(px, py + CELL); // bottom
211:         if (c.walls[3]) ctx.moveTo(px, py + CELL), ctx.lineTo(px, py); // left
212:         ctx.stroke();
213:       }
214:     }
215:     // draw exit portal
216:     ctx.fillStyle = 'green';
217:     ctx.fillRect(exit.x - CELL / 2, exit.y - CELL / 2, CELL, CELL);
218:     // draw player
219:     ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
220:     ctx.beginPath();
221:     ctx.arc(player.x, player.y, PLAYER_R, 0, Math.PI * 2);
222:     ctx.fill();
223:     // draw timer
224:     ctx.fillStyle = 'black';
225:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
226:     ctx.fillText(`Time: ${timeLeft}s`, 10, HEIGHT - 10);
227:   }
228: 
229:   let animId;
230:   function loop() {
231:     movePlayer();
232:     // win check
233:     if (Math.hypot(player.x - exit.x, player.y - exit.y) < CELL / 2) {
234:       endGame(true);
235:       return;
236:     }
237:     draw();
238:     animId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
239:   }
240:   loop();
241: })();

(End of file - total 241 lines)
